name: langcore
short: core framework cog build on top of LangChain framework
description: longcore is the core framework cog for the bot, built on top of the LangChain framework. It provides the foundational abstractions for AI agent orchestration: ChainProvider Abstraction, ChainStore Abstraction and ChainHub. Other cogs connect to langcore either by implementing its abstractions or registering functionality via ChainHub.
author: Tin Nguyen
